remarks: Welcome home to your Manhattan style SONO apartment! This bright clean first floor unit with 20-foot ceilings is a chic 1-bedroom apartment with an open spacious layout. There are hardwood floors throughout, a full-size updated bathroom, kitchen with breakfast bar and plenty of cabinet space. Enjoy the convenience of in unit laundry, an assigned parking space (#39) and ample visitor parking. Don't miss your opportunity to live in this beautiful unit in an unbeatable location. Riverside Plaza is within walking distance to the Metro North train station, Vet's Park, fine restaurants and coffee shops, upscale shopping at nearby SONO Collection mall, and a short drive to Calf Pasture Beach. Start 2026 off in this lovely space, schedule your appointment today! No Smoking/No Pets, sorry. Good credit required, applications pulled through RentSpree.
